sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of azficel-t during breastfeeding. However, azficel-t is a cellular material made from the patient's own fibroblast cells, so it would not be expected to cause any adverse effects in breastfed infants.
